Find an old entry when you remember a word from it. Add filters to narrow a large journal.

## CLI: gournal find

Search your entries for words. Every word must match. The oldest entries come first. Matching can differ between Node builds: with FTS5 a word matches the start of whole words, and without FTS5 it matches any part of the text.

```text
gournal find <text> [options]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `<text>` | yes | Words to search for. Every word must match. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-p, --project <project>` | Only entries of this project. |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Only entries that have all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |
| `-k, --kind <kinds>` | Only entries of these kinds: done, blocker, or next. Separate kinds with commas. |
| `--status <status>` | Only open or only resolved entries. |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `--from <date>` | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `--to <date>` | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | Most entries to return. The oldest come first. |

## MCP tool: find_entries

Search journal entries. Every filter is optional, and filters combine.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Default |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |  |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |  |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |  |
| `text` | `string` | no | Search words. Every word must match. |  |
| `kind` | `("done" \| "blocker" \| "next")[]` | no | Only entries of these kinds: done, blocker, or next. |  |
| `status` | `"open" \| "resolved"` | no | Only open or only resolved entries. |  |
| `source` | `"cli" \| "mcp" \| "migration"` | no | Only entries that came from this source. |  |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Most entries to return. The maximum is 500. | `50` |
| `order` | `"asc" \| "desc"` | no | desc puts the newest entries first. asc puts the oldest first. | `"desc"` |
| `includeDeleted` | `boolean` | no | Also return entries that you removed. |  |

### Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry list](/gournal/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry-list).

## Examples

### CLI

Find entries that match a word.

```console
$ gournal find rounding
Found 2 entries:

Nov Sun 15 - 22:05 757FDB8A [billing-api] Fix rounding error in invoice totals #review
Nov Sun 15 - 23:43 48HE4S3P [billing-api] Add a regression test for tax rounding #review
```

Combine the search with filters. This command finds open blockers only.

```console
$ gournal find webhook --kind blocker --status open
Found 1 entries:

Nov Sun 15 - 23:29 ZY40X9DE [billing-api] Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging 
```

### MCP

Find done and next entries that match a word.

```json
{
  "text": "rounding",
  "kind": [
    "done",
    "next"
  ],
  "limit": 5
}
```

The text result:

```markdown
- 2026-11-15 23:43 `48HE4S3P` [billing-api] Add a regression test for tax rounding #review (next, open)
- 2026-11-15 22:05 `757FDB8A` [billing-api] Fix rounding error in invoice totals #review
```

The structured result lists each entry with all of its fields. This example shows the first entry only.

```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "id": "01M7GJMZJHR4G9D9E848HE4S3P",
      "createdAt": "2026-11-15T21:43:40.881Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-11-15T21:55:40.881Z",
      "deletedAt": null,
      "deviceId": "01M7GKAYPB65ZWS81V3FBKVF3W",
      "summary": "Add a regression test for tax rounding",
      "details": null,
      "kind": "next",
      "status": "open",
      "resolvedAt": null,
      "resolvedByEntryId": null,
      "project": "billing-api",
      "repo": "acme/billing-api",
      "branch": "fix/invoice-rounding",
      "source": "mcp",
      "agent": null,
      "tags": [
        "review"
      ],
      "refs": []
    },
    "... 1 more"
  ],
  "count": 2
}
```
